t: The LAP 1m USB-A to USB-C charging cable is a reliable solution for fast charging and secure data transfer. Delivering 15W power and 480Mbps speed, it supports standard charging and optimised iOS device charging. The braided jacket and reinforced connectors ensure durability in daily use, while the aluminium shell plug adds strength. Fitted with a smart safety chip, the cable protects against overheating and short circuits, making it suitable for workshop, site, or office environments where dependable performance matters.
